# forumulate_space (Data Source)

Looks up a space by its slug (or id): the id every other resource wants, its type and visibility, and its stored settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "forumulate_space" "docs" {
  slug = "docs"
}

resource "forumulate_collection" "guides" {
  space_id = data.forumulate_space.docs.id
  name     = "Guides"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) The space's slug (or its id).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the space was created.
- `id` (String) The space's id (a UUID).
- `item_count` (Number) How many pieces (pages, posts, topics) the space holds.
- `name` (String) The space's name.
- `settings_json` (String) The space's stored settings, as JSON. Decode with `jsondecode()`.
- `type` (String) The space type, such as `DOCS` or `FORUM`.
- `visibility` (String) `PUBLIC` or `PRIVATE`.
